Name: Sikh Turban (Dastar) for Player
Author: Weskoid
Description:
[b][i][u]PREFACE TO GIVE CREDIT WHERE IT'S DUE[/u][/i][/b]

The assets used in this mod were created by a user named [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/notsnufffie.613609/]@notsnufffie[/url] who is no longer a member of the Stardew Valley modding community... notsnufffie deserves all the credit for this mod, as it's using the sprites they originally created for Sikh Harvey. 

This user was responsible for the popular "Diverse - Stardew Valley" mod which is still being worked on by fans. Information can be found here...

[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/diverse-stardewvalley-hiatus-im-dead.109748/]https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/diverse-stardewvalley-hiatus-im-dead.109748/[/url]

[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/diverse-stardew-unofficial-continuation-marnie-added-06-05-18.125163/]https://community.playstarbound.com...al-continuation-marnie-added-06-05-18.125163/[/url]

Without notsnufffie's hard work, this mod would not be possible. Hopefully we see them return to the Stardew Valley modding scene someday, thank you again!

[i][b][u]INSTALL AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION[/u][/b][/i]

This mod replaces the pink Cowgirl hat with Harvey's brown Dastar, available for purchase from the Hat Rat for only 1000g. The Cowgirl item description and name have also been updated for added flavour. 

To install, simply navigate to 
\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer (turban sprites)
and
\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Data (flavour text)
then replace the two hats.xnb files.

Also provided are the loose sprites if anyone would like to recolour the turban or rework it for use with different mods/replace different items. I'm sure there's an easier way of making cosmetic mods, but this is my first for Stardew Valley [img]https://community.playstarbound.com/styles/default/xenforo/clear.png[/img] 
Once "Get Dressed" is updated, I may attempt making the mod compatible with that to avoid replacing any items.

If you do make your own version of this mod, or replace an item other than the Cowgirl hat, I seriously recommend updating the Content\Data\hats.xnb strings to reflect whatever it is you've changed.

As always, make back-ups of your files before installing this.

A very special thank you to Dalia for helping me test all of this and to Tyler for initially sending me the Sikh Harvey files over a year ago.

Of course, an additional thank you to notsnufffie is needed as none of this would be possible without their Diversity Mod.
